items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: conducted by Anthony Brown and Ken Kimery

ctx.x: Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 134 pp.

Today is March 4th, 2011. This is the Smithsonian NEA Jazz Masters oral history interview with Hubert Laws in his home in Los Angeles, California, conducted by Anthony Brown and Ken Kimery. Good afternoon, Hubert. How are you doing?
